scope: All HEAD reachable commit metadata, trees and blobs plus each proposed white-listed public file; intermediate safe roots included. Final audit stored privately after commit.

reviewed_false_positive.reason: literal synthetic rejected localhost URL in security regression; pinned blob and exact literal exception only

scan_limits: Pattern/path screening plus AI per-file review; not independent human/legal/semantic certification; no runtime/private data read.
snapshot_notice: Pre-manifest-commit scan of all history plus final candidate files. Final commit is scanned again before push; final remote receipt retained privately to avoid self-reference.
